answer: During each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and joins a Semaphore membership tree, receiving a private identity and a rate-limited nullifier. It evaluates an epoch polynomial and commits to it. A valid message carries a zero-knowledge proof and polynomial share; two messages using the same nullifier reveal the private key through Shamir interpolation, proving equivocation. The protocol instantly slashes collateral, making every summit, ridge, and mesa costly to duplicate.
